# UI blocks catalog (generated by kit/blocks/gen-catalog.mjs; do not edit)
Compose every screen from these blocks first; hand-write HTML only for what no block covers (fallback: kit/components). Never hand-draw a table, chart, map, plan, timeline, KPI row or nav that a block covers.
Load: list the names in head.json `"blocks":[...]` or do nothing: ui-build also finds `data-k-block` and `K.block.<name>(`. Themes: `K.theme.set('ops'|'control'|'warm')`.
Declarative: `<div id="a-ship" data-k-block="table" data-k-cfg="ship"></div>` in the screen, and in src/screens/NN-<id>.blocks.js `UI_BLOCKS.ship = function (CANON, el) { var D = window.APP_DATA; return {...}; }` with the config below. Imperative: `K.block.table('#a-ship', cfg)`.
Every block also takes `title, subtitle, actions, state ('loading'|'empty'|'error'), emptyText, frame, headingLevel (default 2 = under the screen h1; 3 inside a section with its own h2), colorKeys`. Categories: `K.block.palette({'Stage A':0,...})` once per page keeps a key's colour equal on every screen. Accent: head.json `accent` (blue, green, teal, gold, indigo, violet, rose, orange). Blocks print the numbers they are given (pass totals; they never sum). Time fields take 'HH:MM', an ISO date-time or a JS Date (14:30 today, else 12 Nov, 14:30). A wrong optional field shows an em dash and warns once; text with undefined, NaN or null is flagged (data-k-suspect), fix the data. Put the `a-...` anchor id on the placeholder. Cards side by side in one `k-grid` row: a short card next to a tall one stays short; add class `k-row-fill` to the grid (or `fill:true` on a card) and the blocks whose Config lists `fill` (feed, detail, table...) use the row height (more rows or roomier rows, never a taller row); `fill:'scroll'` scrolls the card inside instead. Every field of a block: the `Config:` comment at the top of kit/blocks/<name>.js.

**bars** Compare categories or a split (delays by cause, jobs by status); horizontal or stacked, values printed, forecast hatched.
`{items:[{label:'Border queue',value:6},{label:'Port congestion',value:5}],total:23,unit:'delays'}`
**board** Cards or rows of items with a status, grouped (vehicles by depot, stages right now, hourly strip).
`{groups:[{title:'Trafford',items:[{title:'BW-01',status:'Ready',fields:[{label:'Departs',value:'06:30'}]}]}]}`
**calendar** Month grid of days with events, prev/next month and an agenda of the picked day; not for the hours of one day (use lanes).
`{month:'2026-11',today:'2026-11-17',events:[{id:'e1',date:'2026-11-18',title:'Dentist',time:'09:30',cat:'Health'}]}`
**chat** Message thread plus composer: bubbles per person, day separators, reactions, send status, typing row; local echo on send.
`{me:'me',people:[{id:'marta',name:'Marta Silva'}],messages:[{id:'m1',from:'marta',text:'Hello',time:'09:12'}],onSend:function(text){}}`
**comments** Threaded comments or reviews with replies, likes, composer and sort; pick for video, post, product and ticket threads.
`{total:1284,composer:{placeholder:'Add a comment',submitLabel:'Post'},items:[{id:'c1',author:{name:'Dev Nair'},text:'Great walk-through',time:'2 h',likes:42,replies:[{id:'c2',author:{name:'Marta Silva'},text:'Thanks!'}]}]}`
**detail** One record's key-value facts in titled sections, plus ordered lists (cargo, vehicle, person, route stops).
`{title:'Cargo and lot',sections:[{items:[{label:'Lot',value:'L-26-0871'}]}]}`
**feed** Alerts, incidents or events ranked by severity, open before closed, times as given.
`{title:'Alerts',items:[{id:'AL-01',title:'SP-2414 line stops tomorrow 06:00',severity:'High',time:'09:55'}]}`
**filterbar** The one-line filter strip (chips, menus, search, reset) above a table, map or feed.
`{groups:[{key:'status',label:'Status',options:[{value:'Delayed'}]}],search:{placeholder:'Search id or carrier'},onChange:function(v){}}`
**inspector** Editable properties panel of the selected thing: tabs, collapsible sections, number/slider/text/select/switch/choice/colour, Reset.
`{subject:{name:'Title card',id:'clip-14'},sections:[{id:'tf',title:'Transform',resettable:true,controls:[{key:'opacity',label:'Opacity',type:'slider',value:80,min:0,max:100,unit:'%'}]}],onChange:function(key,value,sectionId){}}`
**kpi** The row of big counters at the top of a screen (3 to 8 numbers with unit, status, delta).
`{items:[{label:'In transit',value:128},{label:'Delayed',value:7,status:'warn',hint:'3 over 6 h'}]}`
**lanes** Work over time, one row per resource (lineup, shifts, charging plan, beds by bay); now/curfew lines, bands, groups.
`{start:'14:00',end:'02:00',lanes:[{id:'A',label:'Lighthouse'}],items:[{id:'AR-09',lane:'A',start:'23:00',end:'00:00',label:'Lumen Fray'}]}`
**map** Places and routes on a real Europe basemap, cropped to what is shown; edge chips for far places; schematic mode.
`{places:[{id:'a-map-ams',lat:52.309,lon:4.764,label:'AMS'},{id:'a-map-lis',lat:38.781,lon:-9.136,label:'LIS'}],routes:[{from:'a-map-lis',to:'a-map-ams'}]}`
**options** Pick-one-and-confirm decision cards with an impact grid and a recommended mark (2-5 options); layout auto: compare or list by width.
`{items:[{id:'o1',rank:1,title:'Car from the kerb',recommended:true,cost:'EUR 95',impact:[{label:'Crew',value:'none'}]}],onApprove:function(item){}}`
**player** Now-playing bar, podcast card or video control strip: play/pause, seek, volume, shuffle/repeat, like; works without app glue.
`{track:{title:'Night Drive',artist:'Harbour Lights'},duration:225,position:83,playing:true,onPause:function(){}}`
**posts** Feed or grid of post cards (author, media, text, like/comment/share/save); pick for social, photo, video and blog feeds.
`{items:[{id:'p1',author:{name:'Marta Silva',handle:'@marta'},time:'2 h',text:'Sunrise at the pier #harbour',media:{glyph:'\u2600',ratio:'4/5'},likes:1280}]}`
**profile** Header of a person, artist, channel, store or team page: avatar, name, bio, stats, Follow/Message buttons, tab strip.
`{name:'Marta Silva',handle:'@marta',verified:true,stats:[{label:'Followers',value:12400}],actions:[{id:'follow',label:'Follow',pressedLabel:'Following',pressed:false,kind:'primary'}],tabs:[{value:'posts',label:'Posts'}]}`
**rows** Rows with a lead (cover, avatar, number), text and trailing controls: tracks, inbox, cart lines, settings.
`{numbered:true,items:[{id:'t1',title:'Night Drive',sub:'Marta Silva',meta:'Harbour Lights',duration:225,trailing:[{kind:'like'}]}],onChange:function(item,kind,value){}}`
**segmented** A single-choice switch of 2 to 8 short options (depot, day, view, mode).
`{label:'Depot',options:[{value:'TP',label:'Trafford Park',count:11},{value:'SQ',label:'Salford Quays',count:7}],value:'TP',onChange:function(v){}}`
**series** Values over time as lines, steps or areas with threshold lines, value bands and time windows; tickEvery for regular date ticks.
`{x:['2026-10-22','2026-10-23'],series:[{name:'On time',values:[94,92],unit:'%'}]}`
**shell** The app top bar (brand, one-line nav, theme menu, user) and page header; one per page.
`{brand:{name:'SpudTrack',icon:'truck'},nav:[{label:'Dashboard',href:'#/dashboard'},{label:'Shipments',href:'#/shipments'}],user:{name:'Ana Ruiz',role:'Logistics'},page:{title:'Dashboard'}}`
brand.icon draws the app logo from a glyph: film calendar truck leaf music cart chat chart pin bolt ticket mic potato shield heart home book camera wallet plane car cloud gear star users clipboard box rocket paint code (also map, stage, food...). No icon: a logo from the name.
**siteplan** Schematic plan of a site (gate, stages, bays, docks) with labelled paths; not a map.
`{nodes:[{id:'gate',label:'Main gate',x:50,y:90,kind:'gate'},{id:'a',label:'Lighthouse',x:30,y:50,kind:'stage',status:'on time'}],paths:[{from:'gate',to:'a',label:'350 m, 5 min'}],areas:[{label:'Backstage',x:5,y:5,w:35,h:35}]}`
**steps** Ordered milestones or legs with planned and actual times and a status (journey, arrival chain).
`{steps:[{label:'Zaragoza',planned:'08:00',actual:'08:10',status:'done'},{label:'Madrid DC',planned:'14:00',status:'in progress'}]}`
**table** Any list of records: ids never wrap, sort, search, filters, pager, sticky first column, row link.
`{noun:'shipments',columns:[{key:'id',label:'Shipment',type:'id'},{key:'status',type:'status'}],rows:D.shipments,rowHref:function(r){return '#/shipments/'+r.id;}}`
**tiles** Cover cards in a grid or horizontal rail: albums, videos, products, photos, stories; whole tile opens, hover action.
`{title:'Made for you',layout:'rail',items:[{id:'al1',title:'Night Drive',sub:'Marta Silva',actions:[{id:'play',label:'Play',icon:'play'}]}],onSelect:function(item){},onAction:function(item,actionId){}}`
**tracks** Multi-track timeline with a draggable playhead, trimmable clips, zoom and snap; editors, run-of-show, rollouts (lanes = clock-time gantt).
`{duration:60,tracks:[{id:'v1',label:'Video 1',clips:[{id:'c1',start:2,length:12,label:'Intro'}]}],playhead:4,onSeek:function(s){}}`

## Motion (optional, opt-in)
Nothing animates unless an element asks: add an attribute and ui-build inlines kit/motion.css + motion.js by itself. Reduced motion shows the final state. `data-k-anim="fade|fade-up|fade-down|fade-left|scale|blur"` entrance on scroll (`data-k-delay`, `data-k-duration` in ms); `data-k-stagger="70"` on a list or grid staggers its children (`data-k-anim` on it names their effect); `data-k-countup` on a number, or `data-k-anim="count-up"` on a container or kpi placeholder, counts up; `data-k-progress="72"` bar and `data-k-ring="72"` ring (`data-k-tone` ok|warn|bad|info, always an aria-label); `data-k-anim="draw"` on a chart figure or a series/bars placeholder draws it in; `data-k-anim="indicator"` on tabs or a segmented placeholder slides the selected marker; `data-k-anim="type|words"` text reveal; `data-k-anim="marquee"` ticker (has a Pause button); `data-k-anim="check"` success tick; `data-k-confetti` on a button; skeleton: `<div data-k-load="1200"><div data-k-skel><span class="k-skel k-skel-line"></span></div><div data-k-content>...</div></div>`; hover classes `k-lift`, `k-glow`, `k-press`; page-wide, on any element, `data-k-motion="toast dialog page press"` (or `all`) animates toasts, dialogs, screen changes and button presses. JS: `kitMotion.replay(sel)`, `.confetti(el)`, `.loaded(el)`, `.pause()`.
Wow pack (opt-in too; any of these, or head.json `"motion":"fx"`, adds kit/motion-fx): `data-k-morph-open="#dialog"` on a card grows it into its detail (between routes: `data-k-morph="key" href="#/detail"`, `data-k-morph-target="key"` there, `data-k-morph-back="key"` to return); `data-k-tilt` 3D tilt with glare; `data-k-aurora` drifting colour blobs behind a container; `data-k-scramble` text decodes; `data-k-drag="free|snap|home"` cards with inertia and bounce; `data-k-particles="Word"` dots form the word; `data-k-story` with `[data-k-depth]` layers and a `[data-k-draw]` path (scroll); `data-k-magnetic` button; `data-k-shatter="#el"` on a delete button; `data-k-trail` cursor trail (`kitMotion.trail()` = party mode); `data-k-carousel` 3D ring; `data-k-flip[=fold]` over `[data-k-step]`; `data-k-spotlight[=tour]`; `data-k-fireworks` or `kitMotion.fireworks()`. Aurora and particles run one at a time and pause off screen. The cap rose from 11 to 12 KB for these 14 effects.
